scope: two local ARM64 U-Boot builds; no boot-chain deployment or hardware qualification
toolchain: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 local VM; GCC 13.3.0 and GNU ld 2.42
checks: Two fresh source builds produced identical config and binaries; ARM64, Apple architecture and EFI loader options were enabled; readelf identified AArch64.
initial_failure: First local build lacked GnuTLS headers. Installing libgnutls28-dev in the disposable VM allowed two fresh builds.
comparison: Earlier M-series U-Boot builds used GCC 15.2 and recorded a different .config hash; the exact config differences have not been reconciled. The earlier boot-chain assembler rejects this config, and its guard has not been bypassed.
